parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of plastic, located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or pivots slightly when pressed to trigger the flush valve.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Lid)
parts.Basic_description: A ceramic lid that covers the toilet tank, matching the rest of the toilet body.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing components and prevents debris from entering the tank.
parts.Movement_description: It is removable but typically remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Lid (Seat Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid that covers the toilet seat when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a cover for hygiene and aesthetic purposes and can be closed to prevent odors.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A contoured plastic ring that provides a comfortable sitting surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user during use and is designed for comfort and hygiene.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around a hinge for cleaning or access.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic structure of the toilet, including the bowl and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It holds water, supports the seat, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and plumbing.
